releases.notes:
# Better With Hands 1.0.3

Multiplayer fixes, dual wielding that follows your hands, working maps and better compatibility with other mods.

## Features
- New Vanilla indicator style.
- The mod follows the game's left-handed setting. The offhand, the arms and the HUD slot switch sides with it.
- Dual swords: left click hits with the sword in your left hand, right click with the one in your right hand.
- Right click with two swords still gets you into boats and minecarts.
- Dynamic Hand Priority now also picks the hand for attacks.

## Fixes
- Picked up items go back into the offhand first, so torches return to it after breaking them.
- Number keys swap items with the right hotbar slot.
- The hand indicator stays in place with GUI scale override and the vertical hotbar.
- Offhand tools take durability and mining with them follows reach and spawn protection on servers.
- Dual sword attacks with the offhand work on servers.
- Right click on blocks works again while holding two swords.
- Offhand items can be eaten, thrown or used in the air.
- Maps work in the offhand: they update, sync on servers and are held in one hand when the other hand is busy.
- The offhand is kept on respawn with keepInventory.
- Other players see the offhand item with its name and data.
- The offhand updates while a chest or other container is open.
- The offhand slot is hidden on servers without the mod instead of causing errors.
- The offhand arm in third person follows the same pose as the main arm.

## Requirements
- Minecraft: **BTA 8.0.1**
- HalpLibe: **6.2.0+8.0.1**
- Fabric Loader: **0.18.4-bta.11**
- Java 17
- The server needs the mod too for the offhand to work in multiplayer.

## License
- The mod now uses a custom license. See LICENSE.

releases.notes:
# Better With Hands v1.0.1

## Multiplayer Improvements
- Offhand item sync - Other players can now see items in your offhand
- Offhand swing sync - Other players see your offhand swing animations
- Custom packet system - Clean server-side handling for offhand block placement
## Dual-Wield Swords
- Hold a sword in each hand for true dual-wielding combat
- Left click attacks with your offhand sword
- Right click attacks with your main hand sword
- Priority indicator shows on both hands when dual-wielding
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed equip animations being frame-rate dependent (now consistent 300ms regardless of FPS)
- Fixed offhand item not animating out when removed
- Fixed HUD slot slide animation speed varying with frame rate
## Technical
- New packet actions: offhand item sync (action 2), swing broadcast (action 3), use offhand on block (action 4)
- Time-based animation system replaces tick-based approach
- Server broadcasts offhand changes to nearby players within 64 blocks
---

releases.notes:
## Better With Hands v1.0.0

Did you know that you have a second hand? Look down. It's right there. You've had it this whole time.

For years, Steve has been living with a mysterious condition — completely ignoring his left arm. He'd hold a single pickaxe while his other hand just... hung there. Doing nothing. Watching. It's frankly a miracle he survived this long.

**I cured him.**

This is the initial release of Better With Hands for BTA 7.3_04 - a complete reimagining of the offhand system. This isn't a lazy port — it's what dual-wielding should have been from the start.

### Features

- **Dedicated offhand slot** with proper inventory UI integration
- **Full swing animations** - your arm actually moves, torso rotates, no shortcuts
- **Smart rendering** - properly mirrored items in first-person and third-person
- **Dynamic hand priority** - automatically picks the best tool for mining, combat, or building
- **HUD integration** - smooth sliding offhand slot display
- **Multiplayer support** - everything syncs, other players see your animations
- **Left-handed mode** - full support for southpaws

### Controls

- **F** - Swap items between main hand and offhand
- **X** - Toggle hand priority (which hand is "active")

Both keys are rebindable in Options.

### Installation

1. Install [Babric](https://github.com/Turnip-Labs/bta-fabric-instance-repo) mod loader
2. Download `better_with_hands-1.0.0.jar`
3. Place in your `mods/` folder
4. Launch BTA 7.3_04
5. Configure in Options > Better With Hands

### Requirements

- BTA 7.3_04
- Babric mod loader

### Practical Examples

**Mining Setup:** Pickaxe + Torches (mine and place light without switching)  
**Combat Ready:** Sword + Food (fight with instant healing access)  
**Building:** Two block types (swap with X instead of hotbar scrolling)  
**Dynamic Mode:** Pickaxe + Axe (auto-switches between stone and trees)

---

Steve can finally use both hands. You're welcome.
